findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: match_date_check, availability_loop · Private data: query_team_record, query_player_history, compute_aggregate, query_player_rating, query_club, query_coverage · Public sink: prepare_score_entry, match_date_check, availability_loop · Destructive: query_player_rating, match_date_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: match_date_check, availability_loop · Private data: query_team_record, query_player_history, compute_aggregate, query_player_rating, query_club, query_coverage · Public sink: prepare_score_entry, match_date_check, availability_loop · Destructive: query_player_rating, match_date_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
